_about: Declarative map for navigator's OAuth + CAPTCHA console playbooks (pairs with the social-auth and captcha agents). URLs are stable; console UIs drift, so steps describe WHAT to find by visible label, not brittle selectors. The LLM executes these through the backend tier from backend_check.py (these are non-financial dashboards → Tier 1 Claude-in-Chrome usually works; escalate per the matrix if challenged). Harvested values are written via secrets_writer.py into the TARGET project's .env — never here. Client IDs / site keys are PUBLIC (frontend ok); client/app/secret keys are BACKEND-ONLY (secrets_writer GUARD-5 refuses a secret in a VITE_/REACT_APP_/EXPO_PUBLIC_/NEXT_PUBLIC_ var).
_inputs_from_social_auth: social-auth tells you per surface: application type (Web/Android/iOS/Desktop), exact redirect URIs + JS origins (dev+prod), and the env var names to write each credential into. captcha tells you: provider, the domains to allow (host only), and the site/secret env var names.

steps: Confirm with operator WHICH Google account + which Cloud project (one project per business; the Ania apps share one). Use the top-bar project picker or create a project.
Menu → 'Google Auth Platform' (formerly 'APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen'). If unconfigured, click 'Get started'.
BRANDING: App name + user support email → Next.
AUDIENCE: 'External' (any Google account) unless a Workspace-internal app → Next.
CONTACT: developer email → Finish → agree to the User Data Policy → Create.
DATA ACCESS → 'Add or remove scopes' → select non-sensitive: openid, .../auth/userinfo.email, .../auth/userinfo.profile → Update → Save. (These three trigger NO security assessment.)

AUDIENCE tab: status starts 'Testing' (cap 100 testers, refresh tokens expire 7 days). Add the operator + test accounts under 'Test users'. To go live for real users click 'Publish app' → 'In production' (MANUAL gate — see MANUAL-ACTIONS).
google-consent.gotcha: Console moved in 2024-2025: 'OAuth consent screen' is now 'Google Auth Platform' with Branding/Audience/Clients/Data Access tabs. Old guides are stale.

steps: Google Auth Platform → CLIENTS → 'Create client'.

Application type: 'Web application' for React-Vite/Next/Spring backends; 'Android' / 'iOS' for RN-Expo native (RN needs ALL THREE: Web + Android + iOS); 'Desktop app' for JavaFX/CLI loopback. Name it per project.

(Web) Authorized JavaScript origins = the SPA origins social-auth gave you (e.g. https://app.example.com, http://localhost:5173). Authorized redirect URIs = the EXACT backend callbacks (e.g. https://api.example.com/api/auth/google/callback, http://localhost:8080/api/auth/google/callback; Spring-Security default is /login/oauth2/code/google). EXACT match, no wildcards, no trailing-slash drift.
(Android) Package name + SHA-1 of EACH signing key (debug + Play App Signing). (iOS) Bundle ID. Native clients get NO secret.
Create → the modal shows Client ID and (web/desktop only) Client secret → click 'Download JSON' NOW (secret shown in full once; afterwards only last-4).
Harvest: Client ID is PUBLIC; Client secret is SECRET (web/desktop only).
google-oauth-client.gotcha: Client ID may go in a frontend (public) var; the SECRET must go ONLY in a backend var — secrets_writer GUARD-5 refuses a secret in a VITE_/REACT_APP_/EXPO_PUBLIC_ key.

steps: developers.facebook.com → complete developer registration if first time. 'My Apps' → 'Create App'.
App details: name + contact email → Next. Use cases: select 'Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login' (provisions Facebook Login + email/public_profile) → Next.
Business portfolio: connect one or skip → Create app → Go to dashboard.
App settings → Basic: copy the App ID; click 'Show' on 'App secret' (re-auth) to reveal/copy; copy the Client token. Add Privacy Policy URL + App Domains (MANUAL prerequisite for Live).
Facebook Login → Settings: Client OAuth Login ON, Web OAuth Login ON, Strict Mode ON. 'Valid OAuth Redirect URIs' = the EXACT callbacks social-auth gave you (dev + prod). Save.
(iOS/Android) App settings → Basic → Add Platform → enter Bundle ID / Package name + key hashes.
Switch app Development → Live (top toggle) when ready for non-role users (MANUAL gate). In Development only Roles-listed testers can log in (any permission, no review).
facebook-app.gotcha: App ID is public; App secret is BACKEND-ONLY. email+public_profile need no App Review. Strict-Mode redirect URIs are exact-match (the #1 'URL blocked' cause). Email can be null even when granted.

steps: Sign in with the operator's Google account. Label = a human name (e.g. 'myapp-login-prod').

reCAPTCHA type: 'Score based (v3)' for invisible login/register scoring; create a SEPARATE 'Challenge (v2)' → "'I'm not a robot' Checkbox" key for the low-score fallback (v2 and v3 keys are NOT interchangeable).
Domains: add each host the captcha agent gave you (host only — NO scheme/port/path; apex covers subdomains). Add 'localhost' only to a DEV key, never the prod key.
Accept the Terms → Submit.
Harvest: Site Key (PUBLIC) + Secret Key (SECRET). Optionally toggle 'Verify the origin of reCAPTCHA solutions' — if off, the app must assert the siteverify 'hostname' itself.
recaptcha-key.gotcha: Both site and secret keys start '6L' — distinguish by which field the console labels them, NOT by prefix. Domain edits take ~30 min to propagate. localhost not allowed by default.

steps: ALTERNATIVE to reCAPTCHA (not used in the current rollout). dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile → 'Add widget'.

Widget name; Hostname management = each bare FQDN (no scheme/port/path/wildcard; added host covers its subdomains). Widget Mode = Managed (recommended). Optionally enable Pre-clearance for SPA logins.
Create → copy Sitekey (PUBLIC) + Secret key (SECRET).

FASTER ALT: skip the dashboard — use the official Cloudflare API MCP (github.com/cloudflare/mcp) or POST /accounts/{id}/challenges/widgets with a scoped API token to create the widget programmatically, then harvest.
turnstile-widget.gotcha: Turnstile token TTL 300s, single-use. Cloudflare MCP can do widget CRUD without clicking.

steps: Prefer the API CLIs over clicking: Coolify → `coolify-vps/coolify.sh env-set <uuid> KEY value` then `coolify.sh restart <uuid>` (restart, not deploy — Vite rebuilds can OOM). Dokploy → `oracle-vps` dokploy-ops skill / saveEnvironment + redeploy.
Upsert the harvested OAuth + reCAPTCHA vars (backend secrets server-side; public client ids/site keys can be frontend build vars). Flip the *_ENABLED flags on.
Coolify injects env at container create + Spring reads @Value at boot → a restart is REQUIRED to apply.
Confirm DNS first (dig +short <host>) — aniamodels.shop is split across Dokploy and Coolify. After redeploy, hit the health endpoint + GET /auth/config to confirm the flags/keys took.
deploy-panel-auth.gotcha: Coolify env change needs a restart to apply. Frontend public vars are baked at BUILD time — a Vite app needs a redeploy/rebuild (not just restart) to pick up a new VITE_ value.
